page.layout: Two medallion engravings side by side at the top, with their legends. Below them one column of running text in two paragraphs. Right-aligned signature mark below the text. A woodcut ornament at the foot. Running head centred at top, page number top right.

main_text.l: L. CAESAR. C. CAES. DICTAT. PATER.
main_text.p: L. IVLIVS Cæsar,C.Iulij Cæsaris Dictatoris pater , Præ-tura perfunctus,nullis euidétibus caufis obiit Pifis,exanimatus derepéte,dum matutino calceatur. Vide Pli.li.7.ca.52. Fuit hic quoque L.Iulius Cęsar Consul cum Antonio,anno præcedéte Consulatum Ciceronis,qui erat annus à mundo condito 3900. ante verò Christum natum 62. Præturam gessit anno ab hinc quarto:Prætórque Iberos,hoc est Hispanos, ad Oceanũ usque subigit,ac paulò post emoritur. Vide Appi.li.2.

AVRELIA uxor L. Iulij Cæsaris , & mater C. Cæsaris Dictatoris fuit. Vide Sueto.in Cæsaris vita. Porrò Aurelia fami-lia,Romæ olim percelebris,à Sabinis, si Festo credimus,oriun-da,Aurelios nobiles Romanos tulit : qui primùm Aufelij dicti sunt:quemadmodum & Valesij & Papyfij,postea Valerij & Pa-pyrij sunt vocitati.

page.notes: The two medallions are woodcut portraits of Lucius Iulius Caesar and Aurelia, with their legends transcribed above. The woodcut ornament at the foot of the page is not text. The signature "Ll 5" sits right-aligned in the text area, not at the foot of the page; read as a gathering mark. "Ll" may be "L1" in the print. No doubtful readings in the text.
